flow: attached-unit actions exposed to command UI
evidence: CommandInterface calls Unit.e(true) while building selected-unit actions. CustomUnit clears eg, AttachmentBehavior iterates attachedUnits, tests showAllActionsFrom, wraps child actions in UnitSpecificActionProxy, and appends them.
LegOrArmTemplate parser sets metadata flags when drawOverBody/drawUnderAllUnits are declared; CustomUnit draw paths call drawLegLayer with matching booleans.

CustomUnit save/load serializes core leg runtime fields; ensureLegRuntimeStates allocates the array and copies template alpha; LegAnimationBehavior updates movement/height/direction and drawLegLayer renders from those values.
CustomUnitLoader registers the singleton for units with legOrArmTemplates; drawLegLayer reuses the static Rect/RectF/Paint for source/destination rectangles and alpha-adjusted drawing.
